data.name: Business Head - Derma
data.note_for_candidates: Business Head - Aesthetics will own the end-to-end P&L of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business, currently at an early growth stage, with a clear mandate to scale it into a strong specialty franchise over the medium term. The portfolio is focused on specialty dermatology and aesthetics products marketed through clinic-led channels including dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetology practices, specialty clinics, and premium salon networks.
data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A diversified healthcare organization with an established presence in specialty pharmaceuticals and a growing focus on building differentiated, therapy-led businesses across niche and premium segments.

The Opportunity
This leadership role will own the end-to-end P&L of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business, currently at an early growth stage, with a clear mandate to scale it into a strong specialty franchise over the medium term. The portfolio is focused on specialty dermatology and aesthetics products marketed through clinic-led channels including dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetology practices, specialty clinics, and premium salon networks.

The role reports directly to senior leadership and requires a seasoned specialty business leader with strong experience in clinic-driven commercial models, scientific credibility, and the ability to build and scale high-value specialty portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

  • P&L Ownership & Scale-up Mandate: Full accountability for revenue, profitability, and growth of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business.
  • Commercial & Go-to-Market Strategy: Define and execute a differentiated B2B / clinic-led commercial strategy tailored to dermatology clinics, aesthetic centres, cosmetology practices, and premium salon networks.
  • Portfolio & Brand Leadership: Own portfolio strategy across medical dermatology and aesthetics, including brand positioning, pricing strategy, lifecycle management, and premiumization.
  • New Product Development & Launch Excellence: Lead commercialization of current and pipeline products, including advanced Rx and procedure-linked therapies, in close collaboration with R&D, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory teams.
  • KOL & Influencer Engagement: Build strong relationships with dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetologists, and key opinion leaders to drive advocacy, adoption, and market leadership.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance teams to ensure seamless execution from development through commercialization.
  • Team Building & Capability Creation: Build and lead a high-performance specialty sales and marketing organization skilled in clinic-led, relationship-driven selling.


Candidate Profile

  • 15+ years of experience in pharmaceuticals, dermatology, or aesthetics with strong exposure to specialty therapy segments
  • Proven success in clinic-led, B2B, or specialty selling models involving dermatologists, cosmetologists, or aesthetic physicians
  • Strong scientific orientation with the ability to engage credibly with clinicians and key opinion leaders
  • Demonstrated experience owning P&L and scaling specialty or premium portfolios
  • Experience working closely with R&D, medical, regulatory, and commercial teams in specialty product environments
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building and leading high-performance specialty teams
Location: Mumbai

data.name: GM - New Product Development
data.note_for_candidates: This role will lead new product strategy, business development, and NPD execution for regulated international markets, with a focus on Europe, UK markets in Generics. The position requires end-to-end ownership from opportunity identification and deal execution through development oversight and launch readiness.
data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A global healthcare organization with a strong presence in regulated pharmaceutical markets, focused on building differentiated product portfolios through strategic partnerships, complex generics, and specialty-led development.

The Opportunity
This role will lead new product strategy, business development, and NPD execution for regulated international markets, with a focus on Europe. The position requires end-to-end ownership from opportunity identification and deal execution through development oversight and launch readiness.

The role calls for a commercially sharp and strategically strong leader with experience in regulated markets, capable of driving portfolio expansion through in-licensing, co-development, and internal development, while working closely with cross-functional global teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • New Product Strategy & Portfolio Selection: Own product strategy for regulated markets, including identification, evaluation, and prioritisation of new product opportunities. Drive market-backward product selection based on unmet need, competitive landscape, pricing, and regulatory feasibility. Develop business cases for pipeline investments and continuously refine portfolio strategy.
  • Business Development (In-licensing / Out-licensing / Partnerships): Lead in-licensing, out-licensing, co-development, and distribution opportunities across regulated markets. Originate and evaluate opportunities, structure commercial terms, lead negotiations, and manage partner relationships to ensure long-term value creation.
  • NPD Leadership & Project Management: Provide oversight of new product development programs aligned to international market requirements. Drive cross-functional coordination with R&D, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to ensure timelines, milestones, and launch readiness are met.
  • Deal Structuring & Commercial Evaluation: Build financial models, evaluate commercial viability, and define pricing, supply, milestone, and risk-sharing structures for new opportunities. Support investment decisions through strong analytical and strategic inputs.
  • Stakeholder & Strategic Leadership: Act as the single-point owner for international NPD and business development initiatives. Present strategy, pipeline updates, and investment proposals to senior leadership and represent the organization in discussions with global partners, customers, and advisors.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with commercial, technical, regulatory, and manufacturing teams to ensure alignment between portfolio strategy and execution.
  • • Team Leadership: Guide and mentor team members supporting NPD, portfolio, and business development activities, ensuring high-quality execution and strategic focus.

Candidate Profile

  • 15+ years of experience in pharmaceuticals with strong exposure to regulated markets (Europe / UK)
  • Proven experience in NPD, portfolio strategy, or business development within generics, or regulated market environments
  • Strong track record in in-licensing, out-licensing, partnerships, or co-development deals
  • Experience working closely with R&D, regulatory, manufacturing, and commercial teams
  • Strong analytical, financial, and negotiation skills with the ability to evaluate complex opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a global, cross-functional, and high-accountability leadership role
  • Prior experience managing pipeline strategy or international product portfolio will be strongly preferred
Location: Mumbai

data.name: Sales Head - Oncology

data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A fast-growing healthcare technology and precision diagnostics organization focused on advanced oncology solutions, operating across India with plans for international expansion.

The Opportunity
The organization is looking to hire a Sales Head to lead the overall commercial strategy and revenue growth across India and international markets. This is a senior leadership role responsible for building a high-performance sales organization, driving strategic growth initiatives, and strengthening the company’s presence across oncology centers, hospitals, laboratories, and institutional customers.

The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and execution excellence, with responsibility for scaling revenue, building strong channel partnerships, and leading cross-functional collaboration across sales, marketing, clinical, technology, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the overall revenue strategy aligned with the company’s medium- to long-term growth plans

  • Drive consistent annual growth through new channel development, institutional partnerships, and deeper market penetration

  • Build and lead the national sales organization across multiple zones along with an emerging international business

  • Strengthen sales processes, forecasting, pipeline management, and performance tracking frameworks

  • Optimize channel strategy across direct sales, institutional accounts, reference labs, and distribution partners

  • Work closely with marketing, clinical, technology, HR, and leadership teams to ensure alignment of commercial strategy

  • Develop strong relationships with leading oncologists, cancer centers, hospital chains, and key institutional customers

  • Represent the organization at industry forums, conferences, and strategic partner discussions

  • Hire, mentor, and scale a high-caliber commercial team while building strong second-line leadership

  • Drive a performance-oriented culture with clear accountability, review cadence, and incentive structures

Candidate Profile

  • 15–20 years of experience in Oncology, Diagnostics, Molecular, MedTech, or related healthcare commercial roles
  • Proven experience in leading business-unit level sales teams with revenue ownership
  • Strong exposure to oncology-focused portfolios, specialty pharma, diagnostics, or precision medicine businesses
  • Demonstrated ability to drive both strategy and execution in high-growth environments
  • Experience managing multi-zone sales structures and cross-functional teams
  • Strong network across oncology centers, hospitals, laboratories, and institutional customers preferred
  • Ability to operate at senior leadership / CXO level with strong business acumen
  • MBA / PGDM preferred from Tier 1 institutes are preferred
Location: Mumbai

The mandate is to drive business growth across large, medium, and standalone hospitals, with full ownership of P&L, portfolio expansion, institutional partnerships, and team leadership.
data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A well-established Indian pharmaceutical organization with a strong presence in multiple therapies and institutional business, focused on expanding its footprint across private hospital networks in India.

The Opportunity

The role will lead the Hospital Division for a growing pharmaceutical business across private hospitals in India. The mandate is to drive business growth across large, medium, and standalone hospitals, with full ownership of P&L, portfolio expansion, institutional partnerships, and team leadership. The position will play a critical role in strengthening hospital access, expanding chronic therapy presence, and building future-ready commercial capabilities including digital adoption, analytics-driven planning, and structured account management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end hospital business performance including revenue, profitability, market share, and growth.
  • Develop annual operating plans, forecasting, and budgets aligned to business objectives.
  • Track regional performance and refine strategy based on market dynamics and competition.
  • Drive expansion across metro, Tier-1, Tier-2 and Tier-3 hospital markets
  • Lead institutional business across corporate hospital chains, trust hospitals, and standalone institutions.
  • Build strong relationships with hospital administrators, procurement heads, specialists, and key opinion leaders.
  • Ensure formulary inclusion, rate contracts, empanelment and long-term partnerships with hospital networks
  • Drive in-hospital execution, brand availability, and compliance to promotional guidelines.
  • Lead launch execution for new products within the hospital channel.
  • Lead and develop multi-layered teams including frontline managers, regional managers, and sales leaders.
  • Build capabilities in institutional selling, account management, scientific engagement, and digital promotion.
  • Establish performance-driven culture through structured reviews, coaching, and succession planning.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, finance, supply chain, and digital teams for execution excellence.
  • Drive adoption of CRM, analytics, dashboards, and digital engagement tools.
  • Oversee all in-hospital activities including HCP engagement, product education, and supply coordination

Candidate Profile

  • Graduate in Science or Pharmacy; MBA / PGDM preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare sales with strong exposure to institutional or hospital business.
  • Proven track record of managing large turnover businesses (~₹50 Cr or above) with multi-layer teams
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Location: Mumbai

data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A leading global healthcare organization with a strong presence in consumer health across multiple therapy areas.

The Opportunity
This role will lead the national sales strategy for a large and complex Consumer Health / CHC business with significant revenue scale, multi-channel distribution, and strong medical engagement. The position is responsible for driving market share growth, strengthening go-to-market effectiveness, and building a high-performance field organization across diverse geographies.

The role involves leading a large national field force operating across multiple locations and specialties, while delivering annual sales targets, optimizing operating expenses, and building innovative market-shaping initiatives through new go-to-market and omnichannel approaches. The incumbent will play a critical role in strengthening the organization’s presence in the CHC category through strong execution, capability building, and strategic leadership.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership

  • Drive recruitment, training, manpower deployment, and incentive structures to build a motivated, high-performance sales organization.
  • Lead performance management processes, including regular reviews, coaching, and capability development across zonal managers and field force.
  • Build strong leadership capability within the sales hierarchy through structured training, mentoring, and succession planning.
  • Deliver national sales targets, market share growth, and operating expense objectives.
  • Lead forecasting, performance tracking, and corrective action planning to ensure consistent achievement of business goals.
  • Support commercial leadership in sales planning, target setting, and sales mix optimization.
  • Implement effective go-to-market strategies across geographies, channels, and customer segments.
  • Strengthen demand generation through structured doctor coverage, field execution, and brand activation.
  • Partner with KOL and CRM teams to drive strong engagement with healthcare professionals across therapy areas.
  • Build relationships with trade associations, distributors, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure smooth business operations.
  • Support market development initiatives to expand reach, penetration, and brand visibility.
  • Lead sustainability initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Encourage responsible resource utilization and environmentally conscious practices.

Candidate Profile

  • Graduate in Science / Pharmacy; MBA with specialization in Marketing preferred.
  • 20+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical / consumer health industry, with at least 4–6 years leading sales for a business unit or national segment.
  • Strong understanding of sales management, distribution, marketing, and general management concepts.
  • Proven experience managing large field forces and complex multi-channel businesses.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering revenue growth, market share expansion, and team capability development.
  • Strong leadership, execution, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
